{{Quote|Popara's yacht should pull into orbit this evening. I am supposed to meet his factotum at the starport at dawn. Berth Y-27. Meet me there and you'll get a chance to draw your own conclusions.|Mander Zuma, to Reen Irana|<ref name="Scourge" />}}
'''Berth Y-27''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] in operation during the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|era]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mander Zuma]] and his associates [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] rendezvoused at berth Y-27 with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Vago Gejalli Thokka]], a representative of the leader of the [[Anjiliac]] Hutt [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]], [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]]. Zuma and his associates were then transported from the berth to Popara's [[Yacht/Legends|space yacht]] ''[[Imru Ootmian]]'' to conduct negotiations.<ref name="Scourge" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
Berth Y-27 appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']] by [[Jeff Grubb]], an adaptation of the [[2002]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] roleplaying adventure ''[[Tempest Feud]]''.<ref name="Scourge" /> In ''Scourge'', Zuma, Irana and Be'ray fulfill the role of the player characters in ''Tempest Feud''.<ref name="Scourge" /><ref name="Tempest Feud">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref> Whereas in ''Tempest Feud'' the player characters meet with Vago at [[landing bay X23]] on an unspecified world for transport to Popara's yacht,<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> in ''Scourge'' the meeting with Vago occurs at berth Y-27 on Makem Te.<ref name="Scourge" />
